description: This file contains unit tests for the WorkActivityStore class, verifying its behavior in handling jobs and tools, icon state updates, and label extraction in a macOS application context.

methods.name: `main session job preempts other`
methods.description: Tests that a main session job preempts other jobs and correctly updates icon state and current session key.

methods.name: `job stays working after tool result grace`
methods.description: Verifies that the job remains in a working state after tool result handling and within a grace period.

methods.name: `tool label extracts first line and shortens home`
methods.description: Checks that the tool label correctly extracts the first line and shortens the home directory path.

methods.name: `resolve icon state honors override selection`
methods.description: Ensures that resolving icon state respects explicit override parameters.

calls: WorkActivityStore().handleTool(sessionKey: String, phase: String, name: String, meta: Any?, args: [String: AnyCodable])
